mapper.select:
select o.order_id as orderId, o.order_amount as orderAmount, o.pay_state as payState, su.nick_name as doctorName, di.duty_date as dutyDate, di.duty_period as dutyPeriod, hi.hospital_name as hospitalName, sd.dept_name as deptName, o.create_time as createTime from order_info o left join appointments_info ai on ai.appointments_id = o.appointments_id and ai.del_flag = 0 left join duty_info di on di.schedule_id = ai.schedule_id and di.del_flag = 0 left join sys_user su on ai.doctor_id = su.user_id left join sys_user_hospital suh on suh.user_id = ai.doctor_id left join hospital_info hi on suh.hospital_id = hi.id left join sys_dept sd on su.dept_id = sd.dept_id where o.del_flag = 0 and o.user_id = #{data.userId}
and o.pay_state = #{data.payState}
